title: Accessibility: captions, audio description and transcription

videos.script: Every lesson in this course turned one kind of media into another. Speech into text, text into speech, pictures into words. {{title}} That is also what accessibility asks for. Captions turn speech into text for someone who cannot hear it. Audio description turns pictures into speech for someone who cannot see them. {{both}} This lesson builds both for the shop's returns video, with the models of this course. {{build}} The machine gets a long way. Captions in a minute, a transcript with speakers, a check on every image's alt text. {{far}} And then it stops, in places this lesson measures. The narration talks too fast for its own captions, and leaves no room to describe two of the three things the video shows. {{stops}}
